doc: One village building to build: what the game asks for ("the smithy, deluxe, in winter, on its other footprint"), plus the seed that makes it differ from its neighbours and the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: How far its owner has come: construction (a tent on a staked plot), basic, deluxe, or premium. Every stage stands on the same footprint.

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: The type's usual footprint, or its other one.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness: the runtime maps each building's ID onto a capped set of seeds per quality level.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from distance and quality.
